questions.question: The number of clauses used in ISO-9001 are
questions.question_ar: عدد البنود clauses المستخدمة في ISO-9001 هو:
questions.explanation: ISO 9001:1994 organized its quality-system requirements into 20 clauses, numbered 4.1 through 4.20.
questions.explanation_ar: اعتمدت مواصفة ISO 9001 (إصدار 1994 المنهجي في الكتاب) على 20 بنداً أو فقرة متطلبات (20 clauses) تم ربطها مع متطلبات CMM.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.39; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: ISO-9126 contains definitions of
questions.explanation: The ISO/IEC 9126 standard formally structures software product quality into six top-level quality characteristics: Functionality, Reliability, Usability, Efficiency, Maintainability, and Portability. Each characteristic is further refined into subcharacteristics and measurable metrics.
questions.explanation_ar: في معيار ISO 9126، يسمى المستوى الأعلى بخصائص الجودة (Quality characteristics)، وعددها 6 خصائص رئيسية.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.40; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: مفتاح الناشر D يتعارض مع الحل المستنتج من النص؛ بقي السؤال بلا درجة إلى حين المراجعة.
note.en: DISPUTED: Publisher key is D (all of the above); T1 notes argue A (quality characteristics) as ISO 9126 specifically defines characteristics.

questions.question: In McCall quality model; product revision quality factor consist of
questions.question_ar: في نموذج McCall، عامل جودة مراجعة المنتج product revision يتكون من:
questions.explanation: Under McCall's framework, Product Revision focuses on how easily the software can be inspected, repaired, and enhanced. It consists of exactly three factors: 1. Maintainability: Effort required to locate and fix defects. 2. Flexibility: Effort required to modify the software for new operational needs. 3. Testability: Effort required to validate that the software performs its intended functions.
questions.explanation_ar: عوامل مراجعة المنتج (Product Revision) في نموذج ماكول هي ثلاثية الصيانة: سهولة الصيانة (Maintainability) + المرونة (Flexibility) + القابلية للاختبار (Testability).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.42; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED on raw source options. Publisher key (D) exactly matches raw option (D). T1 reordered or altered options, but raw source is preserved.

questions.question: Which is not a software reliability model ?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس نموذج موثوقية برمجيات؟
questions.explanation: The Spiral model is an iterative, risk-driven Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) process model formulated by Barry Boehm. It is not a statistical software reliability growth model. Jelinski–Moranda and Musa's Basic execution time model are established reliability models.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج الحلزوني (Spiral model) هو نموذج دورة حياة لتطوير البرمجيات (SDLC) يعتمد على إدارة المخاطر، وليس نموذجاً رياضياً لقياس الاعتمادية.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.43; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Each maturity model in CMM has
questions.question_ar: كل نموذج نضج في CMM يحتوي على:
questions.explanation: With the exception of Level 1 (which has 0 KPAs), each mature level in the CMM comprises multiple Key Process Areas (KPAs): Level 2 has 6 KPAs, Level 3 has 7 KPAs, Level 4 has 2 KPAs, and Level 5 has 3 KPAs.
questions.explanation_ar: يضم كل مستوى من مستويات CMM الناضجة عدة مناطق عمليات رئيسية (Several KPAs)، تتراوح بين 2 و7 مجالات.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.44; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: KPA in CMM stands for
questions.explanation: KPA stands for Key Process Area. In CMM, a Key Process Area identifies a cluster of related activities that, when performed collectively, achieve a set of goals considered critical for establishing process capability at that maturity level.
questions.explanation_ar: مصطلح KPA يعني منطقة العملية الرئيسية (Key Process Area).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.45; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: In reliability models, our emphasis is on
questions.question_ar: في نماذج الموثوقية، ينصب تركيزنا على:
questions.explanation: Dynamic software reliability models model the observable behavior of the software from the user's perspective; hence, the primary modeling emphasis is on failures (dynamic departure from required operation). Users experience failures, not passive latent faults residing silently in unexecuted source code.
questions.explanation_ar: تركز نماذج الاعتمادية على حالات الفشل (Failures) لأنها الحدث الديناميكي الحقيقي الذي يواجهه المستخدم ويؤثر على الخدمة في الواقع.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.46; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Software does not break or wearout like hardware. What is your opinion ?
questions.question_ar: البرمجيات لا تنكسر ولا تبلى مثل العتاد. ما رأيك؟
questions.explanation: True in the physical sense: software does not wear out through physical aging. It may become obsolete or fail when its environment or requirements change, but those changes are different from hardware wear-out.
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة صحيحة تماماً (True): البرمجيات لا تهترئ ولا تبلى مادياً (Does not wear out) لأنها كيان منطقي غير خاضع لقوانين الاحتكاك والفيزياء.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.47; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Software reliability is defined with respect to
questions.explanation: Software reliability is mathematically defined as a time-dependent probability distribution $R(t)$ measuring the likelihood of failure-free operation over a specified operational time interval. Without specifying a temporal baseline (execution time, clock time, or calendar time), reliability has no mathematical meaning.
questions.explanation_ar: دالة الاعتمادية تُعرّف رياضياً بالنسبة إلى الزمن (Time).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.48; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: MTTF stands for
questions.explanation: MTTF stands for Mean Time To Failure. It is the expected statistical value of the operational execution time of a software system before its next failure event occurs, defined as the integral of the reliability function: $$MTTF = \int_0^\infty R(t) \, dt$$
questions.explanation_ar: اختصار MTTF يعني متوسط زمن حدوث الفشل (Mean Time To Failure).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.49; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: ISO-9000 is a series of standards for quality management systems and has
questions.question_ar: ISO-9000 سلسلة معايير لإدارة الجودة وتحتوي على:
questions.explanation: The original ISO 9000 series comprises five related standards: 1. ISO 9000: Quality management and quality assurance standards — Guidelines for selection and use. 2. ISO 9001: Model for quality assurance in design, development, production, installation, and servicing. 3. ISO 9002: Model for quality assurance in production, installation, and servicing. 4. ISO 9003: Model for quality assurance in final inspection and test. 5. ISO 9004: Quality management and quality system elements — Guidelines.
questions.explanation_ar: تتكون سلسلة معايير ISO 9000 الأصلية من 5 مواصفات مرتبطة شهيرة (ISO 9000, 9001, 9002, 9003, 9004).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 7.50; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.
